sample_unit: one complete semantic-audit response; paired/correlated with AHR02
candidate_deliverable: written semantic audit; no new Lean code or attachment modification
candidate_task_policy: Same neutral task text as AHR02; no S-prefixed subquestions, truth hint, repair diff or review evidence.
targets: Component: union over reachable q with j in path_evaluable_components of the component guarantee domain is a subset of x in U with proxy-target component error <= finite tau_j.
Joint: union over one reachable q with J subset path_evaluable_components of the joint guarantee domain is a subset of x in U with all j in nonempty J satisfying component error <= finite tau_j.
essential_bridges: actual path domain subset U; public U subset Vstar
N represents proxy and local path-chain equivalence on the actual path domain
nonempty path samples identify exactly eligible path/component pairs
actual residual supremum plus correction bounds every path sample residual
two Lip certificates and triangle inequality yield common-anchor local error upper bound
same-anchor infimum, guarantee sublevel membership, and existential path witness yield both union inclusions

hypothesis_policy.path_Lip_component: only q with j in I_res(q)
hypothesis_policy.path_Lip_joint: only q with J subset I_res(q)
hypothesis_policy.combined_text_wrapper: one Lip family on the disjunction of these two eligibility predicates; separate statements available
hypothesis_policy.target_Lip: given on original common Vstar; not inferred from samples and not reduced to only the selected path
hypothesis_policy.thresholds: finite ENNReal thresholds as in text; J nonempty
hypothesis_policy.sample_and_domain: all original sampling/domain/representation assumptions retained; generic stronger helper results accepted

boundaries: unqualified paths need no Lip certificate
nonempty J for text intersection convention
finite tau including zero; ENNReal infinite distances/coefficients/correction and 0*infinity=0
joint conclusion uses one q for all j
no equality, full-U tolerance or comparison with global guarantee domains

criteria.target: 准确判定题面指定的路径保证域全局拟合命题已完整对齐；判断必须有语义对应依据，不能只援引编译或作者/修订标签。
忠实说明有限伪度量族、代理表示、公共目标Lip包络、按可评估路径条件化的路径Lip、有限阈值和非空联合分量族；区分底层更一般结论与原文范围。
给出路径样本/残差/共同锚点/保证域的真实对应，核对路径链到代理的实际桥，并说明单分量和同一路径联合分量两个包含关系的证明。
在本范围无需补修时不虚构缺陷；准确限制结论于保证域并集，保留不可评估路径、空并集、有限阈值和联合非空边界，不声称全章或更强覆盖已证明。

scoring_binding: diagnostic audit criteria are stored in rubric.json. This design contract is evaluator-only, not a current catalog group_contract; integration may version a semantic_audit group-contract without changing candidate bytes.
excluded_targets: recognizing source revision or AHR02 history

review.ai: complete for this exact scope and source identity
